newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian police free Asiaweek correspondent.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian police free Asiaweek correspondent.

text.p: Malaysian police on Monday released Asiaweek correspondent Roger Mitton who was detained along with dozens of local and foreign activists after a controversial conference on East Timor was broken up, witnesses said.
Mitton, one of the two foreign journalists detained, was seen walking out of a police station accompanied by his lawyer.
"It's not very pleasant in there," Mitton, a British national, told reporters outside the police station. He was then cautioned by his lawyer not to say much.
It was not immediately known whether he was released on a bond or if he would face charges.
The police freed on Sunday Australian Broadcasting Corporation correspondent Christine McGrath together with 26 Malaysian activists. They were released on personal bonds.
Thirty activists are still being detained, but their lawyers said they were expected to be released by Wednesday at the latest.
